decisions.reason: The IMU module extends the firm's core sensor Bricklet expertise, and its promotion to its own page in 2024 shows it is being absorbed into the modular platform.
The industrial AC input module builds on the firm's existing input-module and firmware know-how, and it was featured as a new launch with a dedicated page in both years.
A solid state relay module fits naturally into the firm's control and automation building blocks, so it is cheap to keep within the interoperable system even though it gets less prominence.
LED control is closely related to the firm's existing output and LED modules and uses the same APIs and documentation, so the firm can readily interpret early results and refine it.

Remote access for wallboxes supports the firm's strategic push into connected charging and energy management, and its in-house software capability lets it learn from and improve the service, although service business is less familiar territory.
